coverageGaps: Feishu/Lark account binding is an external, one-time QR-code login that Radar cannot perform on the user's behalf; the bridge cannot be exercised end-to-end without it.
DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and a reachable model provider are documented prerequisites and are not supplied to smoke runs.
The safety-net guardian is a separate OS service (systemd/launchd/Windows service) installed by `setup`; service install/status/logs and `/safemode` takeover are not exercised.
Multi-bot instances (`bot add`, per-instance DSH_HOME, hand-off) and outbound notification channels to Telegram/WeCom/WeChat/QQ are not exercised.
The dsh Web Settings -> Plugins configuration surface (host settings namespace plus `./client` browser half) is not exercised by generic smoke checks.
SDK/ACP nested runtime probes (`compat:probe`, `scripts/probe-dsh-compat.mjs`) require network and pnpm and are not reproduced here.

No explicit author Node recommendation was found; Node 22 is evidenced by CI configuration plus the `>=22.19.0` engines floor, and the DSH repository baseline `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` is a platform fact, not plugin intent.
No interactive terminal UI is documented for this plugin; `check:tui-admission`/`check:tui-tty` scripts and the dsh-TUI upstream watch do not establish a TUI plane, so no tuiProfile is recorded.
Radar's incomplete-collection flag is retained separately for any omitted or unavailable repository files.
recommendation.summary: dsh-feishu-bot@0.19.16 (repo dsh-lark-bot, commit 6e722e02) is a dsh profile bundle that bridges DeepSeek Harness into Feishu/Lark. Node 22 is the only evidenced major: every CI workflow (ci.yml, release.yml, cf-pages.yml) configures node-version 22, and engines.node is >=22.19.0 in both source and published manifests. No explicit author Node recommendation was found, so Node 22 is recorded as ci-tested rather than author-recommended; the DSH repository baseline ^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0 is a platform fact and was not used to add a major. Development uses pnpm 10.33.0 (packageManager plus CI setup); pnpm.overrides pin the @deepseek-ai/dsh-* graph to 0.1.0-rc.8 and are development-scoped, since the author documents that overrides are not passed downstream. The manifest declares dsh.client.platform=web, so web is selected; the author documents adapter default `sdk` with switchable `acp` / `headless` / `web`, so all four are recorded with sdk primary. The author's validated DSH baseline is 0.1.0-rc.8 (README compatibility section and the COMPATIBILITY.md matrix row), which is a claim, not a Radar result. DSH_LARK_DISABLED=1 and DSH_LARK_GUARDIAN_DISABLED=1 are retained as additional limited web-plane comparisons. Feishu account binding, credentials, the guardian OS service, multi-bot hand-off and outbound IM channels remain explicit coverage gaps.

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and a reachable model provider are documented prerequisites and are not supplied to smoke runs.
The safety-net guardian is a separate OS service (systemd/launchd/Windows service) installed by `setup`; service install/status/logs and `/safemode` takeover are not exercised.
Multi-bot instances (`bot add`, per-instance DSH_HOME, hand-off) and outbound notification channels to Telegram/WeCom/WeChat/QQ are not exercised.
The dsh Web Settings -> Plugins configuration surface (host settings namespace plus `./client` browser half) is not exercised by generic smoke checks.
SDK/ACP nested runtime probes (`compat:probe`, `scripts/probe-dsh-compat.mjs`) require network and pnpm and are not reproduced here.

No explicit author Node recommendation was found; Node 22 is evidenced by CI configuration plus the `>=22.19.0` engines floor, and the DSH repository baseline `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` is a platform fact, not plugin intent.

recommendation.summary: dsh-feishu-bot@0.19.16 (repo dsh-lark-bot, commit 6e722e02) is a dsh profile bundle that bridges DeepSeek Harness into Feishu/Lark. Node 22 is the only evidenced major: every CI workflow (ci.yml, release.yml, cf-pages.yml) configures node-version 22, and engines.node is >=22.19.0 in both source and published manifests. No explicit author Node recommendation was found, so Node 22 is recorded as ci-tested rather than author-recommended; the DSH repository baseline ^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0 is a platform fact and was not used to add a major. Development uses pnpm 10.33.0 (packageManager plus CI setup); pnpm.overrides pin the @deepseek-ai/dsh-* graph to 0.1.0-rc.8 and are development-scoped, since the author documents that overrides are not passed downstream. The manifest declares dsh.client.platform=web, so web is selected; the author documents adapter default `sdk` with switchable `acp` / `headless` / `web`, so all four are recorded with sdk primary. The author's validated DSH baseline is 0.1.0-rc.8 (README compatibility section and the COMPATIBILITY.md matrix row), which is a claim, not a Radar result. DSH_LARK_DISABLED=1 and DSH_LARK_GUARDIAN_DISABLED=1 are retained as additional limited web-plane comparisons. Feishu account binding, credentials, the guardian OS service, multi-bot hand-off and outbound IM channels remain explicit coverage gaps.
